name: Florence
source:
Don't call her an underling: Florence is an overachiever. With her trademark smile and bubbly personality, she helps to grease the wheels of the public's perception of the political sphere. By running through the entire house, she has a lock on every detail there is to know from the hoi polloi. Just be careful when it comes time to ask her about things swept under her rug...
Likes: Mops, Brooms, Buckets 
Dislikes: Meanies

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
